subject: science

covers: Know that plants are living things, and that some things have never been alive.
Name the main parts of a plant using real plants and models.
Know that plants need light and water to grow.
Explore how seeds grow into flowering plants.
Explore how different animals and plants live in their local environments.
Recognise and name the main external parts of the body.
Notice similarities and differences between people.
Know that a healthy diet has the right food and water.
Explore how the senses help humans and animals notice the world.
Know that humans and animals have young that grow into adults.

gaps: Scientific enquiry (ideas and evidence, planning, obtaining and presenting evidence, considering evidence) has no Stage 1 examples in the public outline.
Chemistry (material properties, material changes, states of matter) has no Stage 1 examples in the public outline.
Physics (forces and motion, light, electricity and magnetism, the Earth and beyond, sound) has no Stage 1 examples in the public outline.
Earth and space: the public 2019 outline puts this under Physics as The Earth and beyond. A later Cambridge page is said to list Earth and Space as its own strand. Not verified from a page read.
Thinking and working scientifically and Science in context: named in a search summary, not seen in a page read. Not verified.
